name: qwen36-27b-blackwell-stress-validation
description: Stress-validation of Qwen3.6-27B inference configurations on dual RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. 5 configs x 4 phases (gates, throughput matrix, HumanEval, MBPP) = 2,105 hard coding problems, zero crashes. Headline: FP8+MTP=3 wins HumanEval (79.3%), BF16+DFlash wins MBPP (89.5%). MTP=5 dominated on correctness despite faster raw tok/s.
